applies_why: The judge text does not count any verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link; it says the challenger answered hēs and marks the point underdetermined.
quote: the challenger answered hēs in [DR3] C2.
rule_words: If the judge says a verse was answered, the judge must not count it. Not counting it obeys this rule.
why: Because the judge expressly treats hēs as answered rather than counting it as an unanswered witness, the text obeys K-G4.
